permanent_risk_requirement.scope: prospective study implementation only; unrelated strategies unchanged

candidate_framework_not_optimized.entry: candidate only after a documented probable-replenishment event at a level during RTH
candidate_framework_not_optimized.stop: candidate protective stop beyond the invalidation side of the tested level by a predeclared fixed tick distance
candidate_framework_not_optimized.target: candidate target at a predeclared next level or fixed reward multiple
candidate_framework_not_optimized.sizing: unspecified; no live or simulated trading authorization

execution_assumptions.fill_basis: bid/ask-aware; buys valued at ask and sells at bid unless actual documented fill evidence is available
execution_assumptions.fees: must use approved current schedule before any evaluation; no fee amount assumed
execution_assumptions.slippage: unknown and separately stress-reported; no zero-slippage claim
execution_assumptions.queue: unknown; no queue-priority or fill-probability claim
